thesis: COLM is in a real post-earnings uptrend (close 74.30 above SMA20/50/200, Sep-26 net income 84.7M vs 52.0M, positive FCF, low dilution risk), and the zone-mid entry 73.2 gives 2.5 R/R to 80.8 against the 70.2 stop. But the pre-market quote of 74.99 is above the 72.4-74.0 zone, and R/R from there is only about 1.2 ((80.8-74.99)/(74.99-70.2)). The Nov 19 reversal from 77.36 marks supply at the 52-week high, which alone gives about 1.4 R. COLM is discretionary apparel, not a defensive name, with 19% short interest and a VIX percentile of 0.995 in a risk-off regime. Per lesson 1 (R/R at the last price below 1.5), this is Hold: watch for a fill in the zone and don't chase. Stop, target and zone are unchanged from the technical card; entry 73.2 is the zone midpoint.
invalidation: Daily close below 70.2 (under the Nov 9-10 swing lows and the post-earnings gap base), or a close back under the SMA20 (~69.3).
key_risks: Risk-off regime (QQQ ret_21 -11.05%, VIX 31.37 at 0.995 percentile) can force liquidation of a stock that ran +25% in 21 days
Short interest 18.97% of float: a squeeze unwind could reverse sharply toward the 66.92 swing low
Supply at the 77.36 52-week high (Nov 19 reversal); the 80.8 target is a measured extension beyond it
Price 74.3 above the analyst mean target 73.0; revenue growth only about 2%, so the earnings jump is margin-driven
Next earnings date not in the packet (likely early Feb 2027, unconfirmed)
